subject: Civic Education
competence: Identifies public services and investigates the need and importance of the time.
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the need of public services.
Investigates information on the beginning and progress of public services.
Presents views appreciating the importance of public services of the times.
Explains the common features related to public services.
the_entrance: Understanding the importance of public services in our daily lives.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduce the concept of public services and their importance.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will brainstorm and list the public services they use daily.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitate student group discussions on the need and importance of public services.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will analyze and discuss the role of public services in their daily lives.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitoring group progress and correcting misconceptions

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Guide student presentations on the importance of public services.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will present their findings and share recorded observations.

summary: Recap of the importance of public services in our daily lives.
post_activity: Concrete homework assignment on the importance of public services
information_sources: National Institute of Education (NIE) Teacher Instructional Guide
attachments: Worksheet on the importance of public services
